input.rationale: Section 12(b) is TrueLink's only indemnity and is confined to claims arising out of TrueLink's breach of this Agreement or failure to perform; there is no duty to defend and no indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach or gross negligence/wilful misconduct (searches for "infringe", "indemnif" and "hold harmless" confirm no IP indemnity anywhere, including §§ 2, 8 and 9). Section 12(a) meanwhile imposes a very broad Client indemnity covering breach of the Agreement, System/Credit Repository defaults, Web Site claims and product/service injury. That fails the fallback (no Vendor IP indemnity at all) and is close to walk-away, so we target preferred. Op 2 adds the Vendor defend-and-indemnify obligation with notice, control of defence and cooperation; per the verifier, its data-breach limb now reaches Client Content, Credit Data and any other data of Client, its affiliates or their customers provided to, transmitted through or processed by TrueLink, so the narrow § 1(d) Credit Data definition (31-day-old, archived, non-combined data) no longer caps the trigger. Op 1 limits our indemnity to Client Content and our own breach of law, deleting the broad "the Web Site or" hook. "Interface", "Hosting Services", "Support Services", "Client Content" and "Credit Data" are all defined, and the § 12 cap (Sections 3, 4, 7, 11) and existing 12(b) indemnity survive unchanged.

proposal.summary: Add TrueLink IP/misconduct indemnity (including all Client data) with standard procedure and narrow Client's indemnity
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity currently covers only its own breach of this Agreement, with no protection for third-party IP infringement claims, breach of law, data breach or gross negligence, while our indemnity is very broad. We have added the Vendor indemnity (covering all Client data provided to, transmitted through or processed by TrueLink) with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, and limited our indemnity to Client Content and our own breach of law; we can discuss an IP-only indemnity with customary exclusions and remedies as a fallback.

ops.oldText: (i) any claim arising out of any breach by Client of this Agreement, (ii) any claim or demand resulting from any act or omission by Client or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client which constitutes a breach of or default by TrueLink under any System Agreement or Credit Repository Agreement, which breach or default has either not been cured or cannot be cured within the applicable cure period and the consequences of which is that TrueLink will lose material rights it has pursuant to said Agreements or a violation of any state or federal law, rule or regulation (iii) any claim arising out of or relating to the Web Site or Client Content (including, but not limited to, any claim resulting from any content posted to the Web Site by Client or Client's employees, agent or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client), without regard to any knowledge limitation or qualification that may be contained in this Agreement, and (iv) injury or damage to person or property caused by a product, service, or information, whether or not defective, that is sold, distributed or transmitted from the Web Site.
ops.newText: (i) any claim arising out of or relating to Client Content (including, but not limited to, any claim resulting from any content posted to the Web Site by Client or Client's employees, agent or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client), and (ii) any breach by Client of any applicable state or federal law, rule or regulation.

ops.text: TrueLink shall defend and indemnify Client and its affiliates against any third-party claim (i) alleging that the Interface, any related software, the Hosting Services or the Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, (ii) arising out of TrueLink's breach of applicable law, (iii) arising out of any unauthorized access to, use or disclosure caused by TrueLink of Client Content, Credit Data or any other data of Client, its affiliates or their respective customers that is provided to, transmitted through or processed by TrueLink, or (iv) arising out of TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. Client shall give TrueLink prompt written notice of any claim indemnified under this Section 12, TrueLink shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, and Client shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.
